The suite is green (9 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped). The existing test cases #137, #138, #139 already cover all three acceptance criteria. The work is done.

**Summary of what was covered:**
- AC-1: Locked-out user sees lockout error and product list is not shown (D6, functional, equivalence-partitioning) — passes
- AC-2: Navigating to product list without signing in shows sign-in page with error (D7, functional, state-transition) — passes
- AC-3a: Sign-in page renders key form elements (D8, functional, error-guessing) — passes
- AC-3b: Sign-in page passes WCAG 2.1 A/AA accessibility scan (D9, accessibility, checklist-based) — passes

**Open bugs relevance:**
- Bug #121 (problem user sees same picture) — does not touch story 110; it concerns the problem_user account on the product list, not the locked-out user flow. Not tested here.
- Bug #122 (error user cannot finish an order) — does not touch story 110; it concerns checkout completion, not sign-in lockout. Not tested here.

**Locator fixes applied:** `getByTestId("user-name")` / `getByTestId("password")` / `getByTestId("login-button")` replaced with role-based locators (`getByRole("textbox", { name: "Username" })` etc.) since the SauceDemo page does not expose `data-test` attributes at the time Playwright queries them with `getByTestId`.

**Test cases:** All three criteria already have linked cases (#137, #138, #139); none were created this run. Suite membership was skipped — this Azure DevOps account has no Test Plans access level.
